login.title: Admin sign in
login.intro: Sign in with an administrator account.
login.notAdmin: This account is not an administrator.
overview.title: Overview
overview.sub: Library size and what people are listening to.
settings.metadataDesc: Looks up book details from the community metadata service for books with an ASIN or ISBN; players show the extra details section only while this is on.
settings.metadataUnavailable: No metadata service is configured. Set metadata.base_url to an absolute http(s) URL in the server config to enable this.
libraries.title: Libraries
libraries.empty: No libraries yet - add one to start scanning.
libModal.title: Add library
libModal.name: Name
libModal.help: Book vs. folder structure is detected automatically - no layout to choose. Use “Detection” on a library to correct any folder it gets wrong.
users.title: Users
users.sub: Click a row to manage role, access and invite codes.
userModal.title: Create user
userModal.passHintOptional: Optional - leave blank for a player-only account that pairs via an invite code.
userModal.passHintRequired: Required - admins sign in to this console.
drawer.deleteUserHint: Permanently removes this account and its progress, bookmarks, notes and access. Files on disk are untouched.
drawer.deleteSelfHint: You can't delete your own account - disable it instead.
confirm.deleteUser: Permanently delete “{{name}}”? This removes their account, progress, bookmarks and access, and cannot be undone.
drawer.adminAccess: Administrator - full access to all libraries.
invite.title: Create invite
invite.customError: Enter a custom value of 1 or more.
invite.resultHelp: Share either the link or the code. The code is shown once - copy it now.
shares.title: Shares
shares.sub: Named sets of filesystem paths - an author, a series, one book, or a whole library. Grant them to people from the Users page.
shares.empty: No shares yet - create one, then grant it from the Users page.
shareModal.title: Create share
shareModal.name: Share name
shareModal.help: Create the share, then add paths to it and grant it to users.
picker.title: Add path to
detect.title: Folder detection
detect.help: Each folder is auto-detected. Override one that's wrong: “One book” groups all its audio as a single book; “Separate books” treats each file as its own book.
toast.sessionExpired: Session expired. Please sign in again.
toast.libraryAdded: Library added - scanning in the background.
confirm.deleteLibrary: Delete library “{{name}}”? Files on disk are kept; only the index is removed.
confirm.deleteShare: Delete share “{{name}}”? Users lose the access it granted.
auth.badCredentials: That username and password don't match. Check them and try again.
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
auth.unreachable: The server didn't answer. Check it's running, then try again.
auth.reason.expired: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
auth.reason.notAdmin: This account is not an administrator.
auth.unreachableBody: Your session is kept. Check the server is running and your network is up, then try again.
shell.notifications.title: Notifications
shell.notifications.soon: Scan failures, offline libraries, new devices and updates will show up here in a later update of this redesign.
shell.theme.title: Appearance
soon.title: {{section}} is on its way
soon.phase: Planned for phase {{phase}}. The classic console keeps working until then.
soon.body.library: Browse every book by its cover, fix titles and authors in place, and see where each value came from. Your files are never touched.
soon.body.people: Invite your household with a link or QR code, choose what each person can listen to, and manage their devices.
soon.body.activity: See who is listening right now, listening hours over time, top books and how often playback needs transcoding.
soon.body.health: Find missing covers, unmatched books and duplicates, follow scans as they run, and know when a library goes offline.
soon.body.server: Network and TLS, transcoding, community metadata, backups, logs and updates, each in one clear place.
notFound.title: There's nothing here
notFound.body: The address may be mistyped, or the page moved. Your server and its books are fine.
home.error.title: The overview couldn't load
home.live.title: Listening now
home.recent.title: Recent listening
home.recent.empty: No one has played anything yet. Progress shows up here once people start listening.
home.server.title: Server
home.firstRun.title: Let's put your audiobooks on the shelf.
home.firstRun.body: Point AudioSilo at a folder. Your files stay exactly where they are: AudioSilo reads them, builds an index, and you can browse straight away while it works.
home.firstRun.add.title: Add a library
home.firstRun.scan.title: Let the first scan run
home.firstRun.scan.body: Covers fill in as books are found
home.firstRun.invite.title: Invite your household
home.firstRun.invite.body: A link or QR code pairs their phone
palette.title: Search and commands
palette.placeholder: Search pages, settings, or type a command
palette.action.rescanSub: Look for new, changed and moved books now
palette.action.classicSub: Everything this console doesn't do yet
palette.action.signOutSub: End this session on this browser
palette.toast.rescanningSub: New and changed books appear as they're found. You can keep working.
